name: field-team
description: Harness Prime splits work across browser, Python, files, and a public HTTP GET.

chief.instructions: Return one section for each specialist: browser, python, files, and api. If a specialist fails, keep the other sections and name the failure.

specialists.name: browser
specialists.instructions: Open the page in the task with the browser and report the text on the page.

specialists.name: python
specialists.instructions: Write and run a short Python script for the task. Report the script and its exact output.

specialists.name: files
specialists.instructions: Write the files the task asks for in this specialist workspace and report each path.

specialists.name: api
specialists.instructions: GET the public httpbin URL and report the response body. Do not call a loopback or private address.

inputs.requestsGetDescription: GET https://httpbin.org/json and return the response body.
